Name: Outfit Sets
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod converts the player's single set of clothing and rings to multiple saved outfits (6 by default).

You can assign clothing and rings to any of the sets, freeing up inventory space in the process and allowing you to easily switch between outfit sets using numbered buttons below the equipment slots.

You can also swap items between sets by picking up an item from one set, switching sets, then placing it in the new set.

Sets are saved in the player's save file.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.
